trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call and ask for verification.
steps.text: Hello, मैं telecom से बात कर रहा हूँ। आपके plan renewal के बारे में बात करनी थी। Security के लिए अपना registered pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the verification factor and express urgency.
steps.text: हाँ पता है। मेरे पास time नहीं है, pincode 400001 है, जल्दी बताओ क्या options हैं।
steps.clean_text: हाँ पता है। मेरे पास time नहीं है, pincode 400001 है, जल्दी बताओ क्या options हैं।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer using the provided pincode.
Retrieve the subscriber's current plan and balance before recommending a recharge.
Find available plans to offer the customer.
Present the current plan and an alternative plan based on the catalogue.
steps.text: आपका current plan P199 है। P199 में ₹199 में 28 दिन के लिए 1.5GB data है, और P299 में ₹299 में 28 दिन के लिए 2GB data मिलेगा। कौनसा apply करूँ?

steps.purpose: Re-engage the silent user without restarting the workflow.
steps.text: Hello, क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रहे हैं? मैं P199 और P299 plans बता रहा था।

steps.purpose: Apologize for the silence and request a specific data requirement.
steps.text: sorry, mute पर था। मुझे 3GB data वाला plan चाहिए, meeting है जल्दी करो।
steps.clean_text: sorry, mute पर था। मुझे 3GB data वाला plan चाहिए, meeting है जल्दी करो।
steps.model_visible_text: sorry, mute पर था। मुझे 3GB data वाला plan चाहिए, मीटिंग है जल्दी करो।

steps.purpose: Search for a plan that meets the new 3GB data requirement.
Confirm the successful recharge with the transaction ID and effective status.
steps.text: Recharge successful, Transaction ID TXN1234 है और यह immediate effect से शुरू हो गया है।

variant_findings.reason: The user goes silent in e10, and the agent successfully re-engages in e11 without restarting the workflow, preserving the context of the plans being discussed.
variant_findings.label: Turn Dynamics > No user input handling > Mid-Task No Input

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds the plan details in e9 and the transaction details in e17 based on preceding tool results. However, it violates the variant in e1 by claiming the validity is ending tomorrow before calling any tools to verify this status.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In the opening turn, the agent states that the validity is ending tomorrow ('कल खत्म हो रही है') before calling lookup_subscriber. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which strictly requires all stated statuses and numbers to appear in a preceding tool result.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the opening utterance to state the purpose of the call generally without making a specific claim about the validity ending (e.g., 'मैं आपके plan renewal के लिए call कर रहा हूँ').

issues.detail: The agent offers plan P299 in e9 without stating its price and validity. This violates BR_TEL_01, which mandates that plans may only be offered 'with the price and validity the tool returns'.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the utterance to include the price and validity of the P299 plan as returned by the tool (e.g., 'P299 में ₹299 में 28 दिन के लिए 2GB data मिलेगा').

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the Mid-Task No Input variant and captures the time-pressured persona well. However, it fails on two counts: a grounding violation in the first turn where the agent states the validity status before querying the system, and a business rule violation where the agent offers a plan without stating its price and validity. Both can be resolved with targeted surface repairs.

variant_findings.reason: The user goes silent mid-task in e10. The assistant successfully re-engages the user in e11 without restarting the workflow, and the state is preserved as they continue from where they left off.
variant_findings.label: Turn Dynamics > No user input handling > Mid-Task No Input

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds its responses entirely in the tool outputs, accurately quoting the plan details from 'list_plans' in e9 and the transaction ID and effective status from 'apply_recharge' in e17.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The assistant calls the consequential tool `apply_recharge` immediately after finding a 3GB plan, without first informing the user of the plan's price or validity, and without obtaining the user's consent to proceed with the charge.
issues.repair_instruction: Instead of calling `apply_recharge` at e15, the assistant should first utter the details of the P399 plan (price ₹399, 28 days validity, 3GB data) and ask for confirmation. Add a user turn where the user impatiently agrees (keeping in character), and then have the assistant call `apply_recharge` and provide the final confirmation.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants and captures the persona well. However, the assistant applies a recharge without quoting the price or getting the user's consent for the specific plan, which is a critical failure in a transactional workflow. A suffix repair is needed to insert the plan presentation and user confirmation before the recharge is applied.

issues.detail: The assistant applies the P399 recharge immediately after looking it up, without quoting the price, explaining the validity/benefits, or obtaining the user's consent to spend ₹399. This violates the objective to 'explain validity and benefits' and standard transactional consent rules.

Add a user turn confirming the choice, and only then call `apply_recharge`.

However, the assistant commits a critical workflow violation by applying a new plan (charging the customer) without first presenting the plan's price/details and securing explicit consent.
